s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and password, as well as data generated through your use of GreenGuard, including uploaded crop images, soil inputs, and prediction history.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.body: Your information is used to provide plant health diagnostics, generate recommendations, maintain your account, and improve the reliability of our AI modules.

s3.title: 3. Data Storage
s3.body: Account and prediction data is stored in a PostgreSQL database and handled according to industry-standard security practices, including password hashing and JWT-based authentication.

s4.title: 4. Data Sharing
s4.body: GreenGuard does not sell your personal data. Information may be shared with the AI processing modules strictly to generate your requested diagnosis and recommendations.

s5.title: 5. Your Rights
s5.body: You may update your profile information at any time and may request account deletion by contacting the GreenGuard team.

s6.title: 6. Changes to This Policy
s6.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Material changes will be communicated through the application.

s7.title: 7. Contact
s7.body: Questions about this Privacy Policy can be directed to the GreenGuard team through the support channels listed in the application.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.body: By creating an account or using GreenGuard, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

s2.title: 2. Description of Service
s2.body: GreenGuard is an AI-powered plant health monitoring and agricultural decision support system. It provides crop image analysis, soil and crop recommendations, weather risk assessment, and fused diagnostic reports to help farmers make informed decisions.

s3.title: 3. User Accounts
s3.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. You must provide accurate information when registering.

s4.title: 4. Acceptable Use
s4.body: You agree not to misuse the platform, including attempting to disrupt the service, uploading unlawful content, or reverse-engineering the AI models that power GreenGuard.

s5.title: 5. AI-Generated Recommendations
s5.body: Predictions, diagnoses, and recommendations produced by GreenGuard's AI modules are provided for informational purposes and do not replace professional agronomic advice. GreenGuard makes no guarantee of accuracy or crop outcomes.

s6.title: 6. Changes to These Terms
s6.body: We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. Continued use of GreenGuard after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

s7.title: 7. Contact
s7.body: Questions about these Terms & Conditions can be directed to the GreenGuard team through the support channels listed in the application.
